question: Through whose grace has the determination of Kaula become known to the speaker?
premises: The Kaula determination is now known
The speaker attributes this knowledge to another's grace
The addressee is addressed as lord of Kaulas
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
